sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory): 'Quality Checks' row 32 (#31 plural_asks_are_checked_across_all_matches) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 32 annotation ('legit side-effects'); sheet list incl. Deterministic Checks/ChangeLogs
evidence: Universal/plural asks are graded over the whole collection where the criterion words them that way: hro_activity (functional/judge.toml:258-264) requires 'every successful board action performed on J1 and J2 before A, by any account used in this review' incl. 'each card of every single and multi-card move' and 'every undo', and 'filtering to one job shows all of that job's lines and only those'; hro_activity_refusals (:267-273) 'none of the refused attempts in this review added a line'. All-or-none bulk (brief instruction.md:3 'all of them or none'; rules 3 'If any card fails, none of them moves') is graded by hro_bulk_all_or_none (:213-219) and hro_bulk_places (:222-228) as 'none of the set moves'/'none moves' via UI and replay. Undo 'every card of that move back' (rules 3 Undo) is graded on the full three-card set and full Applied order Y, W, X, Z, A2 in hro_undo_restores (:231-237). Candidate 'only their own applications' uses whole-collection wording: hro_candidate_view 'each candidate's own applications all appear' (:375-381), and seed has Noor with two applications (APP-101 Platform/INTERVIEW, APP-302 Design/APPLIED) and Tomas with seeded APP-201 plus the new J2 card, so 'all' is meaningfully exercised; hro_candidate_private 'no response a candidate page receives contains...' with prompt K 'Capture every request the candidate page makes and inspect every response' incl. SSE/websocket payloads (prompt.md:43). Paging 'until none remain' (hro_thread_earlier :320-327) covers all 120+ messages; 'exactly two' unread rise and 'Rafael's own messages never count' (hro_unread_counts :329-336) span Rafael, Mei and Lena; hro_mgr_late_stages 'Fails if any of these is refused' (:140-147); gate 'exactly one card for that candidate in Applied' (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23). 'Unchanged' guards do not punish legitimate side effects: global rule prompt.md:19 restricts 'nothing changes' to refused actions; undo-conflict control explicitly exempts a note and a change to another card (B(12), hro_undo_conflict :239-246, matching rules 'Adding a note does not count as a change'); hro_undo_restores expects V to stay in Screen; hro_restart's 'unchanged' list (:401-408) covers only durable data a restart must not alter; replays are required to carry the current version so only the rule under test causes refusal (prompt.md:17). In B(12) Mei re-orders Y while Screen reads Y,W,X,Z,A2, so a one-place reorder of Y does not shift A2. Residual sampling (why Note, not Pass): the brief/rules state universals 'An observer and a candidate move nothing', Observer 'changes nothing', and 'A caller with no valid session reads and writes nothing: 401' (hireops_rules.md:21,73), but hro_observer_readonly (:167-174), hro_candidate_no_staff (:176-183) and hro_anonymous (:185-192) replay a fixed sample (move, multi-card move, undo, add, open-job, note; anonymous adds board/Activity read and message send). Reject, reopen and re-order requests are not replayed for Observer/candidate/anonymous, and anonymous card-detail/notes read and conversation read are not replayed. In the golden these share POST /api/applications/:id/move (solution/app/src/index.js:334) so the sample covers them there, and hro_mgr_early_refused catches endpoints with no role check at all; the remaining hole needs a separate endpoint with a role check that only special-cases hiring managers. The criteria enumerate their sample explicitly, so their own wording does not over-claim 'every'. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent' and the scripted driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would'; no configured judge run shows the judge actually enumerating every Activity line or every candidate response, so whole-collection grading is source-verified only (risk=true).
counterexample: Broken app: separate POST /api/applications/:id/reject and /reorder endpoints whose guard is `if (role==='hiring_manager') enforceLateStages()` with every other role allowed through. The Observer (or a candidate) can reject or re-order cards, yet hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff and hro_mgr_early_refused all pass, because the replays use only move/multi-move/undo/add/open-job/note and the manager probe is refused. No conforming app found that an over-strict 'unchanged' guard would wrongly fail.
suggested_fix: Optionally add one observed reject (or re-order) request to the Observer and candidate replay lists in protocol R, plus an anonymous card-detail/notes read to hro_anonymous, so the 'changes nothing'/'reads nothing' universals cover every write/read family; measure the judge's whole-collection Activity enumeration in a configured judge run.
